newsitem.title: JAPAN: Kobe rubber futures firmer in after-hours trade.
newsitem.headline: Kobe rubber futures firmer in after-hours trade.

text.p: Kobe rubber futures were firmer in after-hours trade on Monday, as a caution over oversold conditions emerged after the November and December contracts hit their life-of-contract lows during the day, traders said.
Prices ranged from 0.3 to 0.9 yen per kg firmer than the day's close. Benchmark February was up 0.3 yen at 139.4 yen.

After the two contracts hit their life-of-contract lows, the market rebounded technically. "The spot September contract could slip further, but an expected intervention by the Thai government to prop up prices in the physical market could limit any falls in distant months," one trader said.
